text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on
the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm Biwa Hayahide. We'll be seeing a lot
of each
other from now on, so let's make
an effort to get
to know one another.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My goal is to devise the perfect winning
equation.
I expect that I'll require your
assistance in proving
my theories.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, I do have some
theories I'd
like to test now. Are you
ready, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
